eyebrow: The School of 2036 · works with Google Classroom
heroBody: Measure your building with its shadow. Split a pizza fairly for 7. Level up like a game, and let a little cedar coach you all the way.
heroFoot: Streaks, badges and a cedar that cheers you on
howTitle: Four steps from “when will I use this?” to “I did this!”

how.s1Body: A real problem from your street, kitchen or balcony, with a 60-second lesson.
how.s2Body: Go measure, build, cook or ask. Safe steps, approved by your teacher.
how.s3Body: Snap a photo and explain out loud. Arzino checks it and asks one question.
how.s4Body: A classmate reviews it. XP, a badge and the next skill unlocks.

gameTitle: Learning that plays like a game

game.streakBody: Keep the flame alive, one mission a day.
game.peerBody: With an AI checklist. Review a friend, earn +15 XP and a point.
game.mapTitle: A skill map that lights up
game.mapBody: Master one skill, the next one opens.

arzinoTitle: A little Lebanese cedar who coaches every student
arzinoBody: Books on his head, a pencil for a crown. Arzino gives hints (never the answer), asks the follow-up question and cheers every win.

arzinoPoints.voice: Talks and listens in Arabic and English
arzinoPoints.safe: Never sees your name or email

campusTitle: A school you can walk around
campusBody: Students move through a 2D campus, wave at classmates and step through glowing doors.

campus.walkBody: Arrows or a tap to move. Emotes to say hi.
campus.studyBody: Invite a classmate. Talk it through with Arzino's discussion cards.
campus.examBody: Arzino asks out loud, you answer by talking. Your teacher can listen live.

rolesTitle: Everyone has a part to play

roles.studentBody: Level up, keep your streak and review your classmates.
roles.teacherBody: Sync lessons from Classroom, approve safe AI missions, see who's stuck.
roles.parentBody: A weekly summary in your language and family missions to do together.
roles.schoolBody: Approve teachers and watch mastery grow across every class.

visionTitle: Rethink school, don't just improve it.
ctaBody: Sign in with your school Google account. Your classes are already waiting.
footer: Built for the Experia Education Hackathon · Beirut 2026
